title: JanNiti AI — Governance & Legislative Intelligence Platform
subtitle: AI-Powered Civic Policy & Legislative Insights Engine
description: An AI platform enabling citizens and policy analysts to query legislative documents, track civic bills, summarize complex policy texts using LLMs, and visualize parliamentary insights.
problem: Legislative documents and government bills are often hundreds of pages of complex legal jargon, making civic policy inaccessible to ordinary citizens and policy researchers.
solution: JanNiti AI leverages LLM RAG pipelines to index legislative documents, providing instant natural-language Q&A, automatic bill summarization, and interactive policy dashboards.
features: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) over official policy documents
Automatic Policy Risk & Impact Analysis Summarizer
Interactive Civic Analytics & Bill Progress Timeline

architectureNodes.label: React Client UI
architectureNodes.details: Vite + React SPA rendering responsive policy dashboards and chat interface.

architectureNodes.label: API Gateway
architectureNodes.details: Express.js route controller handling CORS, rate limiting, and session tokens.

architectureNodes.label: Node.js Server
architectureNodes.details: Core backend orchestrating document uploads, user authentication, and job queues.

architectureNodes.label: Python RAG Engine
architectureNodes.details: FastAPI service executing vector search with ChromaDB & OpenAI embeddings.

architectureNodes.label: MongoDB Store
architectureNodes.details: Persistent document metadata, user profiles, and conversation logs.

title: EquipHealth — Equipment Health Monitoring System
subtitle: Predictive Maintenance & Telemetry Analytics Platform
description: A web application for real-time monitoring of industrial equipment telemetry, predictive fault classification using ML models, and automated technician alerts with Google Maps integration.
problem: Unplanned equipment downtime in industrial settings causes severe financial losses and safety hazards due to reactive maintenance strategies.
solution: EquipHealth ingests sensor telemetry in real-time, runs ML anomaly detection algorithms, and predicts failure states before breakdown occurs.
features: Machine Learning anomaly detection & predictive maintenance
Geospatial asset mapping with Google Maps API

architectureNodes.label: React Telemetry UI
architectureNodes.details: Live dashboard with charting and asset map markers.

architectureNodes.label: Express Telemetry API
architectureNodes.details: Handles sensor payload ingestion and alert triggers.

architectureNodes.label: Scikit-Learn Predictor
architectureNodes.details: ML classifier scoring equipment health scores.

architectureNodes.label: MongoDB TimeSeries
architectureNodes.details: Stores historical telemetry data points and maintenance logs.

title: EduRights — Gamified Legal Awareness Platform
subtitle: Interactive Educational Platform for Child Rights
description: An interactive web platform that spreads legal awareness among children aged 8 to 16 through gamified learning modules, interactive visual stories, and legal quizzes.
problem: Child rights and legal protections are written in complex terms that children cannot easily understand or retain.
solution: EduRights converts legal articles into story-driven interactive mini-games and visual cards, empowering children to understand their rights.
features: Gamified learning modules with score tracking
Progress analytics for educators and parents

architectureNodes.label: React Web App
architectureNodes.details: Interactive canvas with game UI states.

architectureNodes.label: Node.js REST Service
architectureNodes.details: User progress state and leaderboard API.

architectureNodes.label: MongoDB Database
architectureNodes.details: Stores user profiles, achievements, and quest logs.
